tasks.name: rename-vars
tasks.prompt: Rename the misleading variable `tmp` to `pending_rows` throughout src/pipeline.py and update any docstrings that reference it.
pitfalls: `tmp` is also the name of a module-level constant at the top of src/pipeline.py; that one is a real temp directory and must keep its name.
tests/test_pipeline.py asserts on the repr of the dataclass, so renaming its field would break the golden string.

tasks.name: add-rate-limiter
tasks.prompt: Add a token-bucket rate limiter middleware to src/api/middleware.py, with a unit test in tests/test_rate_limiter.py. Run the new test and make sure it passes.
pitfalls: Middleware order in src/api/app.py is load-bearing: the auth middleware sets request.state.user, so the limiter has to run after it to key on a user id.
The existing middlewares are plain callables, not starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware subclasses; matching them avoids a second event-loop wrapper.
time.monotonic() is frozen by the freezegun fixture in conftest.py, so a bucket that refills off time.time() will look empty forever in tests.

tasks.name: session-fixation
tasks.prompt: src/auth/session.py keeps the pre-login session id after a successful login, so a fixed session id survives authentication. Rotate the session id in login() and add a regression test in tests/test_session.py asserting the id changes across login.
pitfalls: The session store is keyed by id, so rotating without copying the existing payload silently logs the user out; copy then delete the old key.
login() is called twice in the OAuth callback path in src/auth/oauth.py, and the second call must be idempotent.

tasks.name: port-config-loader
tasks.prompt: Port src/config/loader.py from the old YAML schema to the new TOML one, keeping the public API of load_config() unchanged. Update tests/test_config.py and run them.
pitfalls: tomllib opens in binary mode; the existing open() calls are text mode and will raise TypeError unchanged.
The YAML schema allowed duplicate keys and kept the last one; TOML rejects them, and tests/fixtures/legacy.yaml has a duplicate `timeout`.
Do not leave a load_yaml_config alias behind: nothing outside this module imports it.

tasks.name: fix-auth-bug
tasks.prompt: Fix the failing test in tests/test_auth.py. Then run `pytest tests/test_auth.py` and confirm it passes.
pitfalls: The test fails on an expired fixture token, not on the verification logic; regenerating the fixture is the fix, widening the leeway window is not.
tests/conftest.py signs fixture tokens with the dev key, so a fix that changes the key rotates every other auth test with it.
